user.title: Create a runtime rule
user.description: Choose a Home Assistant area. The area only filters the entity choices in the next step.

data_description.name: Usually the room and purpose of the rule.
data_description.area_id: Only entities assigned to this area and supporting turn off will be offered.

entities.title: Choose timed entities
entities.description: Select the entities to monitor and turn off. Every selected entity gets its own continuous-runtime clock. The configured First/Last policy decides which active clock triggers shutdown of ALL selected active entities. Unselected entities are never touched. A selected Home Assistant group may control all its members.

data.entities: Entities to monitor and turn off

data_description.entities: Active means any usable state other than off. Attribute-only changes do not restart the timer.

delay.title: Choose the maximum continuous runtime
delay.description: Set the maximum continuous runtime, choose whether the oldest or newest active entity controls the initial deadline, and set a separate retry interval. If an entity remains active after shutdown, it is checked and retried at the retry interval until it turns off.

data_description.delay: How long one selected entity may remain continuously active before the first automatic shutdown.
data_description.retry_interval: How often to check and retry while an overdue selected entity is still active.
data_description.trigger_policy: First uses the oldest active entity. Last waits until the most recently activated entity reaches the runtime limit. Off entities are not included.
data_description.shabbat_entity: When on, automatic shutdowns and retries are paused. An unavailable sensor blocks shutdown for safety.

error.no_supported_entities: No entities supporting turn off are assigned to this area.
error.entity_not_found: A selected entity no longer exists. Choose it again.
error.entity_not_allowed: Choose only enabled entities from this room that support turn off.
error.invalid_delay: Choose a duration between 0 seconds and 30 days
error.invalid_retry_interval: Choose a retry interval between 1 second and 30 days
error.invalid_trigger_policy: Choose first or last active entity

init.title: Edit the runtime rule
init.description: Change the rule name or area, then select Submit to edit the selected entities.

data_description.name: Usually the room and purpose of the rule.
data_description.area_id: Only entities assigned to this area and supporting turn off will be offered.

entities.title: Edit timed entities
entities.description: These entities are both monitored and turned off. Every selected entity has its own continuous-runtime clock; the configured First/Last policy controls the initial deadline. ALL selected active entities are then turned off. Unselected entities are never touched. A selected group may control all its members.

data.entities: Entities to monitor and turn off

data_description.entities: Active means any usable state other than off. Attribute-only changes do not restart the timer.

delay.title: Edit the maximum continuous runtime
delay.description: The counter starts when an entity becomes active and stops when it turns off. Configure the first shutdown time and the later retry/check interval separately. Retry deadlines survive restarts.

data_description.delay: How long one selected entity may remain continuously active before the first automatic shutdown.

data_description.trigger_policy: First uses the oldest active entity. Last waits until the most recently activated entity reaches the runtime limit. Off entities are not included.
